name: O2-QA
description: O2-QA is a high-quality benchmark featuring 300 manually curated, multi-domain open-ended questions with associated web page caches, designed to evaluate performance on complex open-ended and closed-ended open-domain question answering tasks.
reputation: A small but well-regarded open-domain QA benchmark used in research on multi-hop and open-ended question answering, though it is less commonly used than larger QA suites.
notes: Benchmark includes multi-domain open-ended questions with web page caches to support dynamic knowledge acquisition.
